lead: eThekwini's hung council meets on Tuesday to pick a mayor as coalition talks race the 27 November deadline, while the Springboks lost 20-17 in Dublin but still reached the Nations Championship final.

items.title: eThekwini's hung council sits on Tuesday with no coalition deal yet
items.summary: The 223-seat council, where MK holds 86 seats, the DA 57 and the ANC 37, meets on 24 November at the Durban Exhibition Centre to elect a mayor and speaker; 112 seats are needed for a majority.

items.title: New eThekwini councillors registered ahead of five-year term
items.summary: All 223 councillors elected on 4 November were registered at Moses Mabhida Stadium. The city manager says services will carry on without disruption through the handover.

items.title: Councils face 27 November deadline as metro coalition talks continue
items.summary: Municipal councils must be constituted by Friday. An ANC-ActionSA arrangement for the Gauteng metros was reported as likely, after ActionSA's talks with the DA stalled over mayoral candidates.

items.title: KZN launches festive-season safety plan across 184 police stations
items.summary: Premier Thamsanqa Ntuli and acting police commissioner Phumelele Makoba unveiled a phased campaign running to 30 January, with stepped-up road, beach and venue deployments from mid-December.

items.title: Auditor-general flags R780m NYDA youth job spending it could not verify
items.summary: The National Youth Development Agency received a qualified audit for 2025/26, its first after nine clean audits, over payments to NGOs under the presidential youth employment scheme. SCOPA is due to discuss it this week.

items.title: IDC leadership exodus as CEO, CFO and COO head for the exit
items.summary: The Industrial Development Corporation's CEO leaves in February and its CFO this month, while a severance deal is being negotiated with a COO appointed only in September. The state lender reported a R4.65bn annual loss.

items.title: Johannesburg Water restrictions move to Level 2
items.summary: Level 2 water restrictions took effect in Johannesburg from Saturday 21 November.

items.title: Tankers hit in Strait of Hormuz as Iran war drags on
items.summary: Two incidents near Oman were reported by the UK maritime agency, with Iran saying a tanker caught fire after striking a naval mine. Iran also claimed it downed US drones as efforts to end the war remain stalled.

items.title: COP31 climate talks run into overtime with deal in doubt
items.summary: Negotiators in Turkey went past Friday's scheduled close, split over fossil-fuel language and finance for poorer countries; a draft had dropped a proposed $120bn adaptation target.

items.title: Zelenskyy says Trump-Putin-Ukraine meeting possible at Miami G20
items.summary: He said three-way talks could happen at the 14-15 December summit, though Kyiv has no formal invitation, and that Washington wants another round of talks before Christmas.

items.title: Russian strike on Kryvyi Rih kills two and wounds 60
items.summary: A Russian attack on President Zelenskyy's hometown left two people dead and about 60 injured on Saturday.

items.title: Mexico captures cartel boss 'El Chapo Isidro' in Sinaloa
items.summary: Forces working with US intelligence arrested Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, an FBI most-wanted Beltran Leyva leader, sparking overnight roadblocks and clashes in the state.

items.title: Rand hits weakest close in a year amid coalition uncertainty
items.summary: The rand closed at R17.45/$ on Thursday, down 4.4% this month, while the JSE All Share fell to 106,216 after a 3.66% slide on Wednesday. Gauteng coalition worries added to dollar strength and Iran-war pressure.

items.title: SARB holds repo at 7.25% in narrow 4-3 vote
items.summary: Three MPC members favoured a 25-basis-point hike after October inflation rose to 5.2% from 4.5%.

items.title: Big petrol cut on the cards for December
items.summary: Mid-month Central Energy Fund data pointed to cuts of about R2.90 a litre for 95 and R2.65 for 93 petrol, with diesel roughly flat. The weaker rand since then could trim the relief; official prices are due around 2 December.

items.title: Ireland edge Springboks 20-17 but Boks reach Twickenham final
items.summary: Robert Baloucoune scored twice for Ireland; Malcolm Marx crossed for SA, whose losing bonus point secured a final against England or France next Saturday. It is the Boks' first back-to-back defeat since 2022.

items.title: Proteas beat Bangladesh by nine wickets; second Test starts Monday
items.summary: Simon Harmer took 6-51 at the Wanderers for a 1-0 series lead. The second Test begins at Centurion on 23 November, with Temba Bavuma a doubt.

items.title: Arsenal held 2-2 at Newcastle after twice leading
items.summary: Goals from Eze and Madueke were cancelled out by Barnes and Thiaw. Arsenal stay six points clear at the top on 28.

items.title: AI-assisted claims on Navier-Stokes and Riemann stir maths world
items.summary: A 79-page paper claims a blow-up proof for 3D Navier-Stokes with a large Lean formalisation, and a separate claimed Riemann hypothesis proof made with Claude is under scrutiny. Neither has been peer reviewed.

items.title: Amazon reportedly near $7.5bn deal for AI startup Decart
items.summary: The deal could be announced around AWS re:Invent on 30 November, nearly doubling Decart's valuation from May.
